messages:
Anil (CS): Quick alert 5 tenants in EU saw delayed onboarding webhooks overnight (approx 03/22 UTC). Putting together an initial comm + CS playbook. Need: short customer note, who qualifies for remediation credits, and a 1-paragraph exec summary for renewals teams.

Priya (CS): Thanks 5: can you drop the affected tenant ids? I'll start grouping by renewal window and priority.

Anil (CS): Uploaded spreadsheet to the private folder and flagged 9 priority customers.

Rafa (Eng): Root cause: a change in the webhook proxy scaling policy + an unexpected header size increase causing proxies to refuse connections intermittently (502). We rolled back at 2026-03-22T02:57Z and pushed a validation fix.

OpsBot: rollback/service-restart completed for eu-proxy at 2026-03-22T02:57:12Z. Error rate back to baseline within 4m.

Nina (Support): Security check 5: logs reviewed, no unauthorized access or data leakage. Retries were attempted by our system; duplicate delivery detection prevented double writes in most integrations.

Anil (CS): Draft customer note (concise) below. Please edit for tone and brevity before we send to all affected accounts.

Anil (CS): ```
Hi {{customer_name}},

We want to inform you of a service disruption that affected webhook deliveries in our EU region on 2026-03-22 between ~02:45503:05 UTC. Some onboarding and event webhooks were delayed and, in a small number of cases, retried.

What happened: A proxy scaling change combined with unusually large header sizes caused intermittent 502 responses.
What we did: rolled back the change, restarted the EU webhook proxy, and validated delivery consistency for impacted accounts.
What this means for you: Most events were delivered after automatic retries. If you notice missing or duplicate events, reply to this message and we will prioritize reconciliation.
Remediation: Priority customers will receive expedited webhook replay and a one-time account credit. Your CSM will follow up with next steps.

We apologize for the disruption. If you5d like a technical walk-through, schedule a 30-min session here: https://redwood.company/office-hours

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support & CS
```

Priya (CS): Looks good. Suggest we explicitly call out "no customer data was exposed" as customers ask that first.

Anil (CS): Added: "No customer data was exposed or modified as a result of this incident."

Rafa (Eng): ETA for full RCA: internal draft by EOD tomorrow, public digest by Tue EOD. Will link when posted.

BillingBot: Suggested compensation template: "A one-time credit equal to 15% of last invoice month, applicable at next billing or renewal," pending RevOps approval.

Priya (CS): 15% is higher than usual but ok for priority customers. I'll only apply to those with renewals in 60 days. Others get prioritized replay + monitoring.

Anil (CS): CS playbook (short):
- Send initial note to all affected within 2 hours
- For priority accounts: schedule 1:1 recovery sync + run prioritized replay within 36h
- Tag renewal-risk if renewal within 60d and add note to deal in Salesforce
- Offer credit per BillingBot template to qualifying accounts
- Log customer feedback via short form: https://redwood.company/cs-feedback (1 min)

Nina (Support): Add: if a customer reports inconsistent state, escalate to #eng-oncall and include sample webhook_id + timestamps.

Anil (CS): Good call. Adding that to the template.

Priya (CS): I'll draft the outbound email using the above and send for a quick review. If no objections in 20m, we blast.

Rafa (Eng): Quick engineering mitigation notes for the RCA: improved header-size validation in proxy, added regression test for scaling behavior, and tightened CI on proxy config changes.

Anil (CS): Thanks team. Final ask: RevOps/Billing to confirm automation to apply credits for qualifying tenants once we provide the list. Jules? (not in channel)

BillingBot: Please submit credit request via internal billing tool with csv of tenant ids; billing will process within 48h of request.

Anil (CS): Sending initial comm now. I'll post a short status update when the email is sent and again when the RCA link is available.

Priya (CS): Preparing priority sync invites now.

Nina (Support): Monitoring logs and will report any anomalies here.

Rafa (Eng): Will update RCA link here when ready.

Anil (CS): Closing for now; reopen thread if anyone needs to add edits before send.
